slices.title: Group small owners (≤N) by latest TO date
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-14-GROUP-SMALL project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: new feature per owner — group small owners by latest TO date.
Feature: when an owner (physical or legal) has ≤ N units of equipment after all filters, optionally group ALL those units into ONE visit on the date of the LATEST TO among them (i.e. the maximum target date of that owner's units), instead of scheduling each unit on its own target date.

Behaviour: if ON and owner's post-filter unit count ≤ N:
- compute max target date among that owner's units;
- create ONE visit for that owner on that date (respecting grouping window, winter weighting if overdue, etc.);
- all units of that owner go into that visit; Details sheet shows all units with their individual original target dates.
If OFF (or count > N): current behaviour — each unit on its own target date, possibly clustered by window.
Update: scheduler.placement logic; exporter sheet 1 & 2 to show single visit row with multiple units; preview tabs; tests covering ON/OFF, 1/2/3/4 units, mixed physical/legal, overdue + normal dates, winter months.

slices.title: Parser: build address from split columns (region/district/settlement/street/house)
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-16-ADDR-COLUMNS project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: parser reads address from split columns in real export (region/район/населённый пункт/улица/дом in separate cols), not just single "Адрес владельца".
Real export format (owner sample):
  Col A: ЧЕЛЯБИНСКАЯ ОБЛ (region, marker ОБЛ/ОБЛАСТЬ/КРАЙ/АО/РЕСП)
  Col B: КУСИНСКИЙ Р-Н (district, marker Р-Н/РАЙОН) or empty
  Col C: КУСА Г / ЗЛАТОУСТ Г / МЕДВЕДЕВКА С / ТАЙНАК П / ЦЕНТРАЛЬНЫЙ п (settlement, marker Г/С/П/ПГТ/Д/Х/СТ-ЦА/АУЛ/РП)
  Col D..: street, house, etc.
Parser must:
1. After finding header row, scan ALL header cells for address-part markers:
   - region: header contains ОБЛ, ОБЛАСТЬ, КРАЙ, АО, РЕСП, РЕСПУБЛИКА, ОКРУГ
   - district: header contains Р-Н, РАЙОН
   - settlement: header contains Г, С, П, ПГТ, Д, Х, СТ-ЦА, АУЛ, РП (as whole word or suffix)
2. For each row, concatenate non-empty values from these columns in order: region, district, settlement, street, house → full address string.
3. Fallback: if "Адрес владельца" column exists and non-empty, use it (current behaviour).
4. Pass combined address to extractLocation() (already fixed in GRAFIK-15 for bare cities, attached markers, region markers).
Update: src/modules/parser.js (header scan + address assembly), tests for split-column format.

slices.title: Critical: fix date logic for current-year future dates
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-18-DATE-LOGIC project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: CRITICAL business logic fix for date calculation.
Problem: If export has "Дата след. ТО" (or computed next TO) in current year >= today (date of report generation / export date), algo incorrectly treats it as overdue and puts in overdue pool.
Fix: For any target date in current year that is >= export-date (or current date if no export date), treat as "will pass TO on time in current year". Schedule for target year: same month/day (for A4: step 6 months from that date). Do NOT put in overdue pool.
Implementation: in src/modules/scheduler.js computeTargetDates / buildVisits logic. Need export date (from title row "Выгрузка на ДД.ММ.ГГГГ") passed down.
Add unit test: vitest case with export date 23.11.2026, unit with nextTo 26.11.2026 -> scheduled in 2027 on 26.11 (or A4 steps), NOT in overdue.

Goal: schedule physical persons as efficient day routes over nearby settlements. With the new checkbox OFF output must be byte-identical to today (D5 note); regression test for that.
Settings (block 4 "Физлица и малые владельцы", live summary): includePhysical "Включать физлиц в график" (default off); physicalScope "только до порога" (default) | "все физлица"; minUnitsForVisit "Мин. единиц техники для выезда" (default 5); baseSettlement "Населённый пункт инспекции" (pick from reference, start point of routes); maxRadiusKm "Радиус маршрута, км" (default 40); avgSpeedKmh "Средняя скорость, км/ч" (default 50); onsite days checkboxes with "как приёмные дни" (default on); onsite location "у инспекции" (inspectionAddress) | "своя площадка" + address. 1. Eligible physical units -> settlement (address.js) -> stop = settlement x month (overdue and "*" pick the month like legal entities, D14 weighting).

Per month, build day routes greedily: seed = stop farthest from base; add the nearest stop within maxRadiusKm of the seed while day fits (base->stops->base travel + inspection time per D18 rounding, lunch, workday). Order stops by nearest neighbour from base. Large stops split across days by capacity.
4. Route with total units >= minUnitsForVisit -> outbound day on a workday that is not accepting/onsite day; otherwise its units go onsite on onsite days of that month, capacity-split.

slices.title: Fix municipality assignment (area membership), rebuild 74, drop nearest marker
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-37-BOUNDARY-FIX project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Bug in your GRAFIK-32 build: 3757 of 3955 records (95%) got municipality by nearest-centroid fallback, and the marker " (nearest)" was written INTO the data. Cause: scripts/build-settlements.mjs buildGeometry closes each relation member way into its own ring, so a district boundary made of many segments becomes a set of slivers instead of one outline; point-in-polygon then almost never matches.
Preferred fix (simplest, authoritative): drop geometry assembly. Use Overpass area membership - for each admin_level=6 relation already found, fetch its place nodes with: node["place"~"city|town|village|hamlet|locality"](area:3600000000+<relId>); out body; then build records from those nodes. Pause 2-3 s between requests, retry with backoff, resumable. Alternative allowed: correctly stitch member ways into closed rings (shared endpoints) and keep point-in-polygon - only if it reaches the same result.
Output rules: same schema and file path (public/data/settlements-74.json), sorted, minified, <= 700 KB raw; municipality = clean district/okrug name with NO "(nearest)" or any other marker; a node not matching any district must be reported in the log and in the report, never silently assigned.
Tests (tests/settlements-data.test.js): no record contains "nearest" or "("; 100% of records have a municipality (or an explicit allowlist with reasons); spot checks Сатка and Бердяуш -> Саткинский, Тайнак -> Кусинский (per OSM); at least 10 more spot checks of your choice printed in the report.
Also update the measured numbers in docs/analysis/addr-reference-spike.md (exact-assignment count, no fallback).
Report EN <=10 lines: STATUS(done|failed), commit, records, exact=, fallback=, unassigned=, file size raw, spot-check table, tests. No acks.
